interaction.trigger: Open a song from Songs or Repertoire

source.representation: Ruled song list with game and take count

target.representation: Song identity, references and joined recordings

workingState.label: Selected take, mode and playback position

paths.forward: Push a song-ID URL; title/game map to detail and counts disclose their exact recording links. Player remains mounted.
paths.reverse: Return to the same Songs/Repertoire view with search and saved scroll.
paths.interruption: Latest navigation wins; new take selection alone replaces the player.
paths.fallback: Unknown ID shows Song not found and a list return. Missing data shows an error without changing archive playback.
paths.reducedMotion: Navigation is atomic; existing reduced-motion transport rules remain.

identity.commitment: Stable song IDs name list and detail.

spatial.commitment: Detail replaces list in the same main content region.

context.commitment: Left navigation, game identity and exact take relationships remain visible.

state.commitment: Song query and scroll have the same owner; playback stays filename-keyed.

control.commitment: List activation becomes a Back link; transport stays put.

task.commitment: Find the song then inspect its references and recordings.

checkpoints.start: Song row names the title/game and take count.
checkpoints.midpoint: Atomic commit: no interpolated transient layout.
checkpoints.settled: Detail title/game and take IDs agree with the source row.
checkpoints.reverse: Same list query and saved scroll restored.
checkpoints.interrupted: Latest route owns the main pane; only explicit take activation replaces media.
checkpoints.fallback: Unknown/missing data has an honest recoverable state.
checkpoints.reducedMotion: Same IDs, route and playback ownership without animation.
